Access Control List (ACL) – সম্পূর্ণ গাইড

Access Control List (ACL) হলো এমন এক সেট নেটওয়ার্ক রুলস যা দিয়ে আমরা রাউটার বা সুইচের মাধ্যমে ডাটা ট্রাফিক নিয়ন্ত্রণ করি। সহজভাবে বললে, ACL নির্ধারণ করে কে কাকে অ্যাক্সেস করতে পারবে এবং কে পারবে না।

🎯 রিয়েল ওয়ার্ল্ড উদাহরণ:

ধরো একটি অফিসে দুটি বিভাগ আছে — Accounts ও HR। এখন তুমি চাও যেন Accounts বিভাগের কম্পিউটারগুলো শুধু ইন্টারনেট ব্যবহার করতে পারে কিন্তু HR বিভাগের সার্ভারে ঢুকতে না পারে। এই কাজটি ACL দিয়ে সহজে করা যায় — নির্দিষ্ট IP রেঞ্জকে “deny” করে দিয়ে, বাকিদের “permit” করা যায়।

🔍 ACL এর ধরন:

  • Standard ACL: শুধু সোর্স IP ঠিকানার ভিত্তিতে ট্রাফিক নিয়ন্ত্রণ করে।
  • Extended ACL: সোর্স, ডেস্টিনেশন, প্রোটোকল এবং পোর্ট — সব কিছু ভিত্তিতে নিয়ন্ত্রণ করতে পারে।

🧩 Cisco Packet Tracer এ ACL কনফিগারেশন (Zero থেকে):

Step 1: Basic Network Setup

দুটি নেটওয়ার্ক নাও:

Network 1: 192.168.10.0/24  
Network 2: 192.168.20.0/24
Router Interface:
- G0/0 → 192.168.10.1
- G0/1 → 192.168.20.1

Step 2: IP Assign

PC এবং রাউটারে IP অ্যাসাইন করো।

Step 3: ACL তৈরি

উদাহরণ: Network 10 থেকে Network 20-এ অ্যাক্সেস ব্লক করা

Router> enable
Router# configure terminal
Router(config)# access-list 10 deny 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255
Router(config)# access-list 10 permit any

Step 4: ACL Apply করা

যে ইন্টারফেসে ব্লক করতে চাও, সেখানে ইনবাউন্ড বা আউটবাউন্ড হিসেবে Apply করো।

Router(config)# interface g0/1
Router(config-if)# ip access-group 10 in
Router(config-if)# exit
Router# end

Step 5: Verify

PC থেকে ping করে দেখো — Network 10 থেকে Network 20 এ ট্রাফিক ব্লক হয়েছে কিনা।

🧠 টিপস:

  • ACL সবসময় “Top to Bottom” ক্রমে কাজ করে।
  • শেষে implicit “deny all” থাকে — তাই সব রুল শেষে “permit any” দিতে ভুলো না।

CCNA ki? Networking Career-er Sothik Shuruvat

Amra ek digital jogote baas kori, aar ei digital jogoter merudondo (backbone) holo network. Facebook, Google, YouTube theke shuru kore apnar office-er printer porjonto—shob kichui network-er opor nirbhorshil.

Jodi apni ei exciting sector-e career gorte chan, tahole network engineer hishebe apnar journey shuru korar prothom, ebong sobcheye guruttwopurno, dhap holo CCNA certification.

Keno CCNA Ekhono Eto Guruttwopurno?

Technology-r jogot onek druto bodle jacche, kintu CCNA-r chahida ekhono opar. Er karon holo eti shudhu "kivabe" (how) noy, eti "keno" (why) shekhay. Ei foundational knowledge apnake complex network-er somossa samadhan (troubleshooting) korte shaajjo kore.

Job market-e CCNA-r ekta alada mullo ache. Hiring manager-ra ei certificate-ke vishon-vabe pradhanno den, karon eta proman kore je apnar network fundamentals-er opor sposto dharona ache. Eti apnar CV-ke onnoder theke alada kore rakhe.

Adhunik CCNA-te (200-301) Notun ki ache?

Adhunik CCNA (version 200-301) ekhonkar projuktir sathe taal miliye onek updated. Eti shudhu traditional routing/switching-e simaboddho noy. Ekhon er moddhe included ache:

  • Automation & Programmability: Network automation-er dharona, jemon Python, Ansible, ebong DNA Center-er sathe porichoy.
  • Security Fundamentals: VPN, wireless security (WPA3), ebong port security-r mool dharona.
  • Wireless Networking: Wi-Fi 6 ebong WLC (Wireless LAN Controller) er basic concepts.

Porishesh

Jodi apni network engineering-e ekta successful career gorte chan, tobe CCNA holo tar shera shuruvat. Eti apnake shudhu ekta bhalo chakri petei shaajjo korbe na (jemon: Network Engineer, System Admin, Network Support), borong apnar poroborti specialization (jemon CCNP, Cyber Security, ba Cloud Networking) er jonno ekta shokto vitti toiri kore debe.

shortDesc.stringValue: This app is a simple account management tool for mess Manager & Members. Easily track deposit, expenses, dues, and monthly reports.

technology.stringValue: JavaScript, CSS, HTML, Firebase, Android Studio

fullDetails.stringValue:
How to Download & use the App?

First, click the Download App button below to download the app.Now unzip the downloaded file, then install and open the app on your phone.

Manager Mode

As soon as you open the app, you will see two options:

  • Manager
    •
  • Member
    •

To use the app as a Manager, first select the mode and sign up. Then, log in to your account. Once logged in, you’ll enter your Manager Dashboard.

From here, tap the “+” icon from the Member section to add new members. Next, go to the three-line (hamburger) menu, where you’ll find the following settings options:

  • Change App Name
    •
  • Bind Code
    •
  • Change Password
    •
  • View Previous Reports
    •
  • Support
    •
  • Close Monthly Accounts
    •

From here, click on Bind Code, and you will get a code similar to an IPv4 address. Copy this code and share it with your members.

Member Mode

Once you select Member Mode, you’ll be asked to enter a Bind Code. Paste the Bind Code provided by your Manager and click Search. You’ll then see your Mess Name and a dropdown box below it. Click the dropdown, select your name, and click Enter. This will take you to the Member Dashboard. Here, you’ll find the options:

  • My Account
    •
  • Everyone's Accounts
    •
  • Market Request
    •

From this section, you can view both your own and everyone’s accounts in the mess. If you spend your own money on market purchases, you can also submit a request to the Manager to add that expense.

APP Features-Manager

The Manager only needs to add the members’ names, their deposited amounts, meal counts, and market expenses. That’s it. The Manager’s job is done. The app will automatically handle all complex calculations and provide instant results. On the Dashboard, you can accurately view every calculation, including:

  • Total Deposits
    •
  • Total Expenses
    •
  • Remaining Funds
    •
  • Total Meals
    •
  • Meal Rate
    •
  • Each Member’s Deposit
    •
  • Each Member’s Meal Count
    •
  • How much each Member should receive or pay
    •

In short, the app shows everything from A to Z instantly and accurately.

You’ll find many more amazing features in this app! From the Manager Panel, when you click the Meal button, a calendar of the month will appear along with the days of the week. If there are no meals added on certain days, you’ll see two colored boxes Dark Red and Green. When a meal is added for a specific date, that date’s box will turn Yellow.

Here’s what the color codes mean:
  • Dark Red – No meal recorded on this date
    •
  • Green – Today’s date
    •
  • Yello – Meal updated for this date
    •

These color indicators help the Manager easily identify which days’ meals have been updated. If a meal update is missed, the red box will make it immediately clear which date was left out. The most exciting features of this app are the Monthly Account Close and Previous Report View options. Making mess management smarter and more organized than ever!

Let’s say, in a month, Sadiq deposited 3000 BDT and his total expenses for the month were 2500 BDT, while Abid deposited 1500 BDT and his total expenses were 2200 BDT. At the end of the month, Sadiq will receive 500 BDT, and Abid will have a 700 BDT deficit. The Manager does not need to keep track of this separately. When the Manager closes the month, the app will automatically update these balances in the current month’s deposits: Sadiq’s 500 BDT will be added to his deposit. Abid’s 700 BDT deficit will appear as a negative balance. Even if, by any chance, the Manager forgets to close the month, the app will automatically close the month on the 1st of the next month, update all members’ balances, and start the new month’s account seamlessly.

And Manager can view previously closed month’s accounts by clicking on “View Previous Reports”. This allows them to see the reports for the last 3 months.

Support

Under the Support option, you’ll find Mail, Instagram, Facebook, and Website.From now on, you can easily get app-related support directly via Mail or the Website.

APP Features-Member

From the Dashboard, when a member clicks on My Account, they can view all their account details:

  • Meal Rate
    •
  • Total Meals
    •
  • Total Expenses
    •
  • Total Deposits
    •
  • Remaining balance or amount they need to pay
    •

Clicking on Total Meals will show the number of meals they had on each date of the month.

Similarly, from the Dashboard, if they tap Everyone's Accounts, they can view everyone’s account details. Clicking on Total Expenses will show what items the Manager purchased, when, and for how much.

Market Request

This is the most awesome feature in Member Mode! If, in the Manager’s absence, a member spends their own money for the mess:

    1. They can enter the expense details and amount and tap Send.

    2. The request will be sent to the Manager, who will receive a notification in their app.

    3. A red dot will appear on the icon whenever a new notification arrives.

    4. The Manager can Approve or Decline the request.

Once approved, the expense is automatically added to the mess’s total expenses, and the member’s amount is added to their deposit. No manual work is required at all. The app handles everything automatically.

So Download and Enjoy the APP. Thank Me latter
